citations.claim: NS green at step 324, one step before yellow
NS yellow lasting only 1s at step 325
first yellow_duration violation at step 326: yellow lasted 1s vs required 3s, now all-red before EW

counterfactual.change: Set actuated false (fixed-time) keeping all else identical; full yellow is then honored and no violation occurs.

explanation: Actuated NS green ran very long (~74s from ~step 251 to 324). When EW demand (W queue) appeared, the controller's actuated/recall switch cut NS yellow short: green at 324, yellow only at 325, red/all-red at 326, i.e. a 1s yellow instead of 3s. Fixed-time control of the identical scenario shows no violation, confirming the actuated termination path truncates yellow.
vision_note: NS approaches are green through step 324, then show yellow only in step 325. By step 326 all four approaches are red, so the yellow lasts just one second.
